three_day_minimum.why: keeps chat 1's 3-day excavator minimum, which chat 2 replaced with a flat 95.00 delivery fee

minimum_and_fee.why: adds chat 2's 95.00 delivery fee but keeps the 3-day minimum it replaced

half_from_day_5.why: off by one: half the day rate from the fifth day on, not after it

same_day_full_day.why: charges a same-day return as one full day, the usual minimum, instead of half a day rate
